deps.edn.reason: The git floors on bytes, io and test point at repositories that are bundled here as kotoba.bytes, kotoba.io and kotoba.test; they become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The comment above :deps, :paths and :aliases are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (alias :oracle, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.
